title: Chapter 189
text:
[Deterrence] completed.

You have received 120000 EXP.

+ 500 Blood Pact Society Favorability. Current Relationship: Respected (4450/6000)

The Blood Pact Society was a subordinate force of the Dark Net. Favorability could affect the relationship with the Dark Net, just like how Han Xiao's favorability with Division 13 affected Stardragon's attitude toward him. According to Han Xiao's estimation, he still needed an opportunity to activate the Dark Net, such as a mission. The higher the favorability of the subordinate force, the more it would affect the initial favorability of the superior force.

This mission is not difficult. There are probably hidden benefits, like increasing Bennett's favorability. Han Xiao nodded. When he returned to the Southern Continent, he would have a place in the shelter's main mission. He was looking forward to it.

…

After a busy night, Dorasi finally returned home under the protection of the new bodyguards. He could not hide his fatigue.

When he passed by the study, he realized that the desk lamp was on. Just as he was about to turn it off, he saw a document on the table that he had never seen before.

Dorasi's expression changed. He hesitated for a few seconds and slowly flipped through the document.

The document was filled with evidence of his secret profits and his dark past. It was signed by the Dark Net.

"The Dark Net sends our sincere greetings to you. We wish you good health."

Dorasi's face turned green. He immediately understood why the Dark Net did this. It was only a matter of material support. He did not expect the Dark Net to be able to find out about his opposition.

He slammed the document on the table and gritted his teeth. "This is too much. This is extortion. A bunch of robbers!"

If they could sneak into his house, it meant that they could also take his life. That person was from the Dark Net! Everything that happened tonight was orchestrated by the Dark Net!

However, he did not dare to take revenge. If this information fell into the hands of his enemy, his political career would be over. He would definitely be abandoned by his backer. Without the protection of his political party, he would definitely be eliminated. As an official, he knew Maple's style the best.

Dorasi immediately burned the document and collapsed on the chair as if his bones had been removed. Staring at the document that had turned into Ashes in the fireplace, he was silent for a long time.

"This can't be made public. I'm not the only official who opposes funding the Dark Net. The others won't be stupid enough to reveal it." Dorasi's eyes flickered. If everyone kept their mouths shut, this matter could be kept under wraps. No one would know, and it would become a secret between them. As long as they agreed to the material aid, the Dark Net would not do anything else.

However, things were always unexpected. Of the five officials who were invaded, one was found dead, and his corpse was hidden in a cabinet! This immediately attracted a higher level of attention. The secret service personnel sealed off the official's mansion and thoroughly investigated the house. Han Xiao was scared to death at the time, so he wouldn't put up a file. Naturally, the intelligence agency didn't find anything.

However, they had their own guesses. Out of the five people involved, only one had died. Why were the other four fine? What was the infiltrator's motive? The intelligence agency asked Dorasi and the other three if they had noticed anything unusual, but they all denied it. But at the same time, the intelligence agency found that the five parties had something in common. Not long ago, they had all opposed the proposal to fund the Dark Net.

The Dark Net was the most suspicious!

The infiltrator was able to fight with the Legends of the old era and disappear in the blink of an eye. Red Maple's intelligence agency immediately locked onto the most suspicious target — the Dark Net's Black Phantom!

If that was the case, the four of them must have lied. But why was the dead official killed?

The doctor checked the cause of death and found that the dead official did not have any external or internal injuries. The cause of death was actually a myocardial infarction due to high adrenaline secretion. In short, he was scared to death!

What did the dead official see when he was alive? Why was he scared to death?

Did he see a ghost?

What did Black Phantom do?

Thinking about it, Red Maple's intelligence agent was terrified.

"What a terrifying assassination method. It's natural, not leaving any traces. God-level disguise. Unbelievable!"

The intelligence agent quickly recorded it down.

Everyone in the underground world knew how difficult it was to deal with Black Phantom. It was almost impossible to find him. Red Maple's intelligence agency could only do their best and leave the rest to fate. They were mentally prepared for futility.

…

Vernina was half-naked. She sat in the chair with her hands on the back of the chair and her chin on the back of her hands. Hannes was treating the wound on her shoulder behind her back. Beside him were cotton balls that were soaked in blood.

Ding dong.

Hannes finally removed the bullet that was embedded in the flesh and threw it on the plate.

The pain made Vernina frown. She sighed and said, "I can't believe I failed such a simple mission. How embarrassing."

While doing the stitches, Hannes said without raising his head, "Gerian's information is wrong. It's all his fault."

Hearing that, Gerian threw the computer on the table. The page was the file of the secret service personnel around Dorasi. He scolded, "Bullsh * t, this is all the information I managed to get from Red Maple's archives. That strong enemy's name is Angston. Look at his resume. He's just a normal person. Who knew he hid so well?"

Vernina put on her white sweater and combed her blonde hair. She said calmly, "With this failure, it won't be easy to kidnap the next target. That Angston is not easy to deal with."

Gerian looked at the computer and was suddenly overjoyed. He said, "No, I have new information. The one we fought was a fake. He's not from Red Maple."

"Who?" Hannes was surprised.

"Seems like someone from the Dark Net." Gerian typed on the keyboard and stole the information.

"Dark Net … Only Bennett and the other two old guys are strong. They're not the ones I fought. Does the Dark Net have new blood? I haven't been paying attention to the underground for a while. " Vernina was slightly surprised. She touched her shoulder. "He even left a bullet hole in me. He's not someone to mess with."

"We don't have any conflicts with him. We're just unlucky," Gerian scolded. "We just had to meet someone strong. Bennett really found a treasure."

"Asking directly is the fastest way." Hannes took out his phone. He had Bennett's number.

The call went through.

"Hannes? I didn't expect you to call me. Didn't you retire? "Bennett's voice sounded.

"Gerian said he needed my help with something important. I owe him a favor anyway. Let's not talk about this. I have something to ask you. Did you send someone to Red Maple to do something?" Hannes explained everything.

Bennett didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "What a coincidence. I don't know if he's unlucky or you guys are unlucky."

"Who is he?"
